mechanism_claims.claim_text: Brevinin-1RL1 induces both apoptosis and necrosis in tumor cells; morphology, Annexin V/PI, sub-G1, TEM, and LDH evidence support the bounded claim.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Brevinin-1RL1 in HCT116 and A549 tumor-cell assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact plotted percentages are figure-only; qualitative/prose-supported mechanism direction is recorded without digitizing bars.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=5:2.3. Brevinin-1RL1 Induces Cell Apoptosis and Necrosis

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The apoptotic component is caspase dependent and involves extrinsic and mitochondrial intrinsic pathways, supported by caspase/PARP cleavage, JC-1 mitochondrial membrane potential loss, and z-VAD-FMK rescue.
direct_assay_types: JC-1 mitochondrial membrane potential flow cytometry
mechanism_claims.limitations: Recorded as pathway-level support; no unreported molecular target is inferred.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:2.4. Brevinin-1RL1-Induced Cancer Cells Apoptosis Is Caspase-Dependent

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FITC-labeled Brevinin-1RL1 preferentially aggregates on tumor-cell surfaces compared with NCM460 and BEAS-2B non-tumor cells.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FITC-labeled Brevinin-1RL1 localization in tumor and non-tumor cell lines
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source frames this as a preliminary mechanism; the final record does not claim a specific lipid or protein binding target.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=7:2.5. Brevinin-1RL1 Aggregates on the Surface of Tumor Cells

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The C-terminal disulfide/Rana-box contributes to antitumor activity because reducing the disulfide deprived the peptide of antitumor activity in the source MTS comparison.
direct_assay_types: MTS cell viability assay comparing Brevinin-1RL1 and Brevinin-1RL1red
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanistic role is bounded to structure/activity contribution; the source says further study is needed for alpha-helix formation involvement.
